answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 18696 Country: India Title: Can you please suggest a dua for my sister who is trapped in a non-muslim's hand. my family is completely worried abt this. Question: Dear Mufti Saab, As-salam alaikum, Can you please suggest a dua for my sister who is trapped in a non-muslim's hand. my family is completely worried abt this. please help us and give some dua's with which she would become proper and start walkign in the right path. Answer ID: 18696 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 97/97=B=1431) Recite durood 100 times, لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم 500 times daily for fourteen days and supplicate to Allah. In-shaAllah, you will get out of this trouble. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
